current_bottleneck: Direct level-space future-path FM is too support-loose. Even with sequence-aware history conditioning, the model still learns mostly generic overspread paths, with flat conditionality and poor anchoring of realistic level/jump support.
last_result_summary: Iteration 49 ran 268b-v0, adding sequence-aware history-to-future conditioning to direct path-space FM. It regressed to 1/11. Conditionality stayed flat, while explosion, level KS, and cross-cell mean correlation all worsened. This makes direct level-space FM itself the likely bottleneck, not just the conditioning summary.
next_step_recommendation: Do not keep patching direct level-space FM. Shift 268 to direct conditional future-change flow matching in a generic normalized change coordinate, then test whether the tighter stochastic object restores support and conditional structure without latent machinery.
current_best_model: Archived baselines retain the overall frontier at 4/11; the restart line now treats 268 direct path-space FM as a live but not yet frontier-matching family.
current_best_note: 268a reached 3/11 and showed the family is alive, but 268b indicates level-space direct FM is the wrong stochastic object. The next move is a change-space reformulation, not more conditioning patches.
